title: WPSS/274/2013 of CHANDRA KANT GUPTA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and ANOTHER

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No.274 of 2013
Chandra Kant Gupta ÖÖ..Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand & another ÖÖ.Respondents
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
1. Mr. Lalit Belwal, Advocate, for the petitioner.
2. Mr. T.P.S. Takuli, learned Brief Holder, present
for the State/respondents.
3. The petitioner is a Junior Engineer (Civil) in
Nagar Palika Parishad, Sitarganj, District Udham Singh
Nagar. According to him, he has been denied promotion to
the post of Assistant Engineer.
4. Admittedly, the promotion to the post of Assistant
Engineer is done from amongst Junior Engineers on basis
of ìseniority subject to rejection of unfitî. Since according to
the respondents, there are ìadverseî remarks in the service
book of the petitioner for the last many years and a
departmental proceedings against the petitioner also
pending, the petitionerís candidature has not been
considered for promotion.
5. The petitioner, on the other hand, denied that
there is no inquiry pending and as far as the ìadverseî
remarks in the service record are concerned, according to
him, same have not been communicated to the petitioner,
therefore, reliance placed by the respondents on those
ìadverseî remarks cannot be taken into consideration.
6. Petitioner also contends that two increments for
the past years have also not been given to him.

2
7. In view of the above mentioned facts and
circumstances, the writ petition is disposed of with the
direction to the respondents to at least consider the case of
the petitioner for promotion to the post of Assistant
Engineer and if he is not liable to be promoted, assign
reasons while denying it to the petitioner. As far the
increments, the same be also considered in accordance with
law, within 12 weeks from the date a certified copy of this
order is produced before him.
8. In case there are some ìadverseî remarks against
the petitioner, which have not been communicated to the
him, those ìadverseî remarks shall be communicated to the
petitioner, so that, he may make representation against
such ìadverseî remarks.
9. No order as to costs.
